## Synopsis

```text
perch gc [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Remove orphaned local blobs, dead letters older than --dead-letter-age, enforce the S3 spool limit, and optionally delete S3 objects for deleted messages. An incremental vacuum runs by default.

## Notes

- --s3-delete is ignored in SQLite mode.
- Without --s3-delete, S3 tombstones accumulate.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--dry-run` | report what would be removed |
| `--s3-delete` | delete S3 objects for deleted messages |
| `--dead-letter-age <value>` | delete dead letters older than this (default: 720h0m0s) |
| `--vacuum` | run incremental vacuum after cleanup |
| `--spool` | enforce storage.s3.spool_max_bytes |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch gc --config /etc/perch/perch.yaml --dry-run

perch gc --config /etc/perch/perch.yaml --s3-delete
```
